mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study (id, study_code, tenant_id, owner_id, canonical_config, cohort_definition_version, feature_registry_version, data_cutoff_at, leakage_check_status, status, progress, warnings, idempotency_key, created_at) values (#{id}, #{studyCode}, #{tenantId}, #{ownerId}, cast(#{canonicalConfig} as jsonb), #{cohortDefinitionVersion}, #{featureRegistryVersion}, #{dataCutoffAt}, #{leakageCheckStatus}, #{status}, cast(#{progress} as jsonb), cast(#{warnings} as jsonb), #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select id, study_code as studyCode, tenant_id as tenantId, owner_id as ownerId, canonical_config as canonicalConfig, cohort_definition_version as cohortDefinitionVersion, feature_registry_version as featureRegistryVersion, data_cutoff_at as dataCutoffAt, leakage_check_status as leakageCheckStatus, status, progress, warnings, error_code as errorCode, idempotency_key as idempotencyKey, created_at as createdAt, started_at as startedAt, completed_at as completedAt, cancelled_at as cancelledAt from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and study_code=#{studyCode} and deleted_at is null

select id, study_code as studyCode, tenant_id as tenantId, owner_id as ownerId, canonical_config as canonicalConfig, cohort_definition_version as cohortDefinitionVersion, feature_registry_version as featureRegistryVersion, data_cutoff_at as dataCutoffAt, leakage_check_status as leakageCheckStatus, status, progress, warnings, error_code as errorCode, idempotency_key as idempotencyKey, created_at as createdAt, started_at as startedAt, completed_at as completedAt, cancelled_at as cancelledAt from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} and deleted_at is null

select id, study_code as studyCode, tenant_id as tenantId, owner_id as ownerId, canonical_config as canonicalConfig, cohort_definition_version as cohortDefinitionVersion, feature_registry_version as featureRegistryVersion, data_cutoff_at as dataCutoffAt, leakage_check_status as leakageCheckStatus, status, progress, warnings, error_code as errorCode, idempotency_key as idempotencyKey, created_at as createdAt, started_at as startedAt, completed_at as completedAt, cancelled_at as cancelledAt from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and deleted_at is null order by created_at desc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}

select id, study_code as studyCode, tenant_id as tenantId, owner_id as ownerId from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study where status='QUEUED' and deleted_at is null order by created_at asc for update skip locked limit 1
mapper.update: update cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study set status='RUNNING', started_at=#{startedAt}, version=version+1 where id=#{id} and status='QUEUED' and deleted_at is null

update cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study set progress=cast(#{progress} as jsonb), version=version+1 where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and study_code=#{studyCode} and status='RUNNING' and deleted_at is null
mapper.select: select status from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and study_code=#{studyCode} and deleted_at is null
select progress::text from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and study_code=#{studyCode} and deleted_at is null
select id from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and study_code=#{studyCode} and deleted_at is null
mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study_sample (id, study_id, sample_type, stock_code, market, event_trade_date, anchor_at, event_type, matching_metadata, source, coverage) values (#{id}, #{studyId}, #{sampleType}, #{stockCode}, #{market}, #{eventTradeDate}, #{anchorAt}, #{eventType}, cast(#{matchingMetadata} as jsonb), cast(#{source} as jsonb), cast(#{coverage} as jsonb)) on conflict (study_id, sample_type, stock_code, market, event_trade_date) do nothing

insert into cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study_sample (id, study_id, sample_type, stock_code, market, event_trade_date, anchor_at, event_type, matching_metadata, source, coverage) values
(#{sample.id}, #{studyId}, #{sample.sampleType}, #{sample.stockCode}, #{sample.market}, #{sample.eventTradeDate}, #{sample.anchorAt}, #{sample.eventType}, cast(#{sample.matchingMetadata} as jsonb), cast(#{sample.source} as jsonb), cast(#{sample.coverage} as jsonb))
on conflict (study_id, sample_type, stock_code, market, event_trade_date) do nothing
mapper.update: update cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study set status='CANCELLED', cancelled_at=#{cancelledAt}, completed_at=#{cancelledAt}, version=version+1 where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and study_code=#{studyCode} and status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') and deleted_at is null

update cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study set status=#{status}, leakage_check_status=#{leakageCheckStatus}, progress=cast(#{progress} as jsonb), warnings=cast(#{warnings} as jsonb), error_code=#{errorCode}, completed_at=#{completedAt}, version=version+1 where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and study_code=#{studyCode} and status='RUNNING' and deleted_at is null
mapper.select: with latest_snapshot as ( select distinct on (snapshots.code, snapshots.market) snapshots.code, snapshots.market, snapshots.trade_date, snapshots.available_at, snapshots.amount, snapshots.source::text as source, snapshots.coverage::text as coverage, snapshots.feature_payload from cynexus_appl_market.a_stock_daily_factor_snapshot snapshots where snapshots.trade_date < #{eventDate} and snapshots.available_at <= #{dataCutoffAt} and snapshots.feature_version=#{featureVersion} order by snapshots.code, snapshots.market, snapshots.trade_date desc ) select snapshots.code, snapshots.market, snapshots.trade_date as featureTradeDate, snapshots.available_at as availableAt, snapshots.amount, snapshots.source, snapshots.coverage, coalesce(snapshots.feature_payload ->> 'market.state', marketPhase.phase) as marketRegime, coalesce(snapshots.feature_payload ->> 'industry.phase', industryPhase.phase) as industryRegime, coalesce((snapshots.feature_payload ->> 'stock.float_market_cap')::numeric, basics.float_market_cap) as floatMarketCap, concat_ws('|', coalesce(ths_membership.industry_name, 'UNAVAILABLE'), coalesce(tdx_membership.industry_name, 'UNAVAILABLE')) as industry, coalesce(basics.is_st, true) as st from latest_snapshot snapshots left join cynexus_appl_market.sec_stock_basic basics on basics.code=snapshots.code and basics.market=snapshots.market and basics.is_active is true left join lateral ( select industry_name, industry_code from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_membership_snapshot memberships where memberships.code=snapshots.code and memberships.market=snapshots.market and memberships.effective_trade_date < #{eventDate} and memberships.membership='ths' order by memberships.effective_trade_date desc limit 1 ) ths_membership on true left join lateral ( select industry_name from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_membership_snapshot memberships where memberships.code=snapshots.code and memberships.market=snapshots.market and memberships.effective_trade_date < #{eventDate} and memberships.membership='tdx' order by memberships.effective_trade_date desc limit 1 ) tdx_membership on true left join lateral ( select phase from cynexus_appl_market.trade_review_trend_phase phases where phases.trade_date=snapshots.trade_date and phases.scope='MARKET' order by phases.window_days desc, phases.updated_at desc limit 1 ) marketPhase on true left join lateral ( select phase from cynexus_appl_market.trade_review_trend_phase phases where phases.trade_date=snapshots.trade_date and phases.scope='INDUSTRY' and phases.membership='ths' and phases.industry_code=ths_membership.industry_code order by phases.window_days desc, phases.updated_at desc limit 1 ) industryPhase on true

select trade_date as featureTradeDate, available_at as availableAt, source::text as source, coverage::text as coverage, close, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.volume')::numeric as volume, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.amount')::numeric as amount, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.turnover_pct')::numeric as turnoverPct, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.return_1d')::numeric as return1d, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.return_3d')::numeric as return3d, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.return_5d')::numeric as return5d, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.return_10d')::numeric as return10d, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.return_20d')::numeric as return20d, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.return_60d')::numeric as return60d, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.return_120d')::numeric as return120d, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.return_252d')::numeric as return252d, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.ma5')::numeric as ma5, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.ma10')::numeric as ma10, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.ma20')::numeric as ma20, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.ma60')::numeric as ma60, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.close_vs_ma5')::numeric as closeVsMa5, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.close_vs_ma10')::numeric as closeVsMa10, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.close_vs_ma20')::numeric as closeVsMa20, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.close_vs_ma60')::numeric as closeVsMa60, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.volume_vs_ma5')::numeric as volumeVsMa5, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.volume_vs_ma10')::numeric as volumeVsMa10, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.volume_vs_ma20')::numeric as volumeVsMa20, (feature_payload ->> 'stock.volume_vs_ma60')::numeric as volumeVsMa60 from cynexus_appl_market.a_stock_daily_factor_snapshot where code=#{code} and market=#{market} and trade_date < #{eventDate} and available_at <= #{dataCutoffAt} and feature_version=#{featureVersion} order by trade_date desc limit #{sessions}
mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study_sequence_snapshot (id, study_id, study_sample_id, frequency, sequence_code, offset_value, observed_at, available_at, raw_value, normalized_value, source) values (#{id}, #{studyId}, #{sampleId}, #{frequency}, #{sequenceCode}, #{offsetValue}, #{observedAt}, #{availableAt}, #{rawValue}, #{normalizedValue}, cast(#{source} as jsonb)) on conflict (study_sample_id, frequency, sequence_code, offset_value) do nothing
mapper.select: select samples.stock_code as code, samples.market, samples.event_trade_date as eventTradeDate, samples.sample_type as sampleType, points.frequency, points.sequence_code as sequenceCode, points.offset_value as offsetValue, points.observed_at as observedAt, points.available_at as availableAt, points.raw_value as rawValue, points.normalized_value as normalizedValue, points.source from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study_sequence_snapshot points join cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study_sample samples on samples.id=points.study_sample_id join cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study studies on studies.id=points.study_id where studies.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and studies.owner_id=#{ownerId} and studies.study_code=#{studyCode} and studies.deleted_at is null and points.sequence_code=#{sequenceCode} order by points.sequence_code asc, samples.sample_type asc, samples.event_trade_date desc, samples.stock_code asc, points.offset_value asc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study_factor_result (id, study_id, discovery_code, recipe_version, discovery_method, scope, recipe, learned_bounds, statistics, validation, evidence, verdict, rank) values (#{id}, #{studyId}, #{discoveryCode}, #{recipeVersion}, #{method}, #{scope}, cast(#{recipe} as jsonb), cast(#{learnedBounds} as jsonb), cast(#{statistics} as jsonb), cast(#{validation} as jsonb), cast(#{evidence} as jsonb), #{verdict}, #{rank}) on conflict (study_id, discovery_code, recipe_version) do update set statistics=excluded.statistics, validation=excluded.validation, evidence=excluded.evidence, verdict=excluded.verdict, rank=excluded.rank
mapper.select: select results.discovery_code as discoveryCode, results.recipe_version as recipeVersion, results.discovery_method as method, results.scope, results.recipe, results.learned_bounds as learnedBounds, results.statistics, results.validation, results.evidence, results.verdict, results.rank from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study_factor_result results join cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study studies on studies.id=results.study_id where studies.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and studies.owner_id=#{ownerId} and studies.study_code=#{studyCode} and studies.deleted_at is null order by results.rank asc, results.created_at asc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}

select samples.stock_code as "code", samples.market, samples.event_trade_date as "eventTradeDate", samples.sample_type as "sampleType", samples.outcome_snapshot::text as outcomes from cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study_sample samples join cynexus_appl_market.market_factor_study studies on studies.id=samples.study_id where studies.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and studies.owner_id=#{ownerId} and studies.study_code=#{studyCode} and studies.deleted_at is null order by case when samples.sample_type='EVENT' then 0 else 1 end, samples.event_trade_date asc, samples.stock_code asc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}
